messages:
maria.p: @here Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a short role-owner verification sweep for SOC2/ISO evidence next week (window: Mon 03/30 → Fri 04/03). Managers need to confirm training completions and access ownership for their direct reports and any service accounts they own. Minimal acceptable artifacts: training completion cert, policy acknowledgement screenshot, or a brief audit CSV. Please use the form here: https://go.redwood/checklists/role-owner-sweep :eyes:

maria.p: Checklist (paste this into the form or attach):
```
- Employee name
- Role/Team
- Manager
- Training name & completion date (or "N/A")
- Accesses owned (prod/gcloud/aws/github) or service account name
- Evidence link (gdrive/screenshot) or ticket #
```

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — auto DM to listed managers at 2026-03-30T09:00Z :bell:

jamal: Does this include infra service accounts? I have about 12 that are shared across pipelines. :thinking_face:

maria.p: Yes — include service accounts and map them to an owner. If a SA is shared across teams, list the primary owner and note collaborators. If you need an exception window, open a security ticket with the reason and expected remediation date.

elaine: OOO 3/30-3/31, leaving an owner list in the form now. cc @ryan in case anything needs follow-up. :wave:

ryan: Got it. I'll take infra + SRE items. Will attach CSV with columns matching the checklist. ETA EOD Tue. :white_check_mark:

tara: Quick Q — are microtraining acknowledgements from last year still valid, or do we need fresh completions?

maria.p: Microtraining done in the last 12 months is acceptable. If someone's completion is older, mark as "stale" and either retake or note planned completion date.

jamal: Uploaded CSV to the form and added links to screenshots. Ping me if anything looks off. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: Automated follow-up will run Thu 2026-04-02T16:00Z for outstanding submissions.

ryan: FYI — for infra owners, I'll include a quick owner mapping doc and a list of service accounts with last-used timestamps. That should satisfy the evidence ask.

maria.p: Thanks all — managers, please confirm your team's items by Fri EOD. If you need extra time, mention it in the form and we'll route to security for an exception. :pray: 

elaine: noted — thanks!

tara: I'll check with my ICs and upload anything missing by Thursday. :eyes:

jamal: thanks — appreciate the heads-up.

ops-bot: Thread closed by scheduling rule. Final automated summary will be posted in #people-ops on 2026-04-06.
